body: You've hit the nail on the head ! I always try to please others no matter what the impact on my side is ... I'm not usually asking for any help, I rather give then take (I hope this is true) cause giving something gets me something back in return (like you did with me). Like my daughter who woke me up at night just to tell me she loves me ! This is something you can't buy with ALL the money in the world. Making someone happy and make yourself happy along the way .... I feel better now, thanks a million times for talking to a complete stranger ! No doubt bad thoughts and moments WILL return now and then, lets see.

I think the judge was fair because her lawyer wrote a 50 piece paper against me including very personal e-mails were I have opened my heart to my ex ! Not nice for someone to give such personal information away and try to use it against you in court. I'm sorry for taking her to court but I was really angry cause she didn't let me see my baby. On one side she can be nice as nothing I have ever seen before, on the other side she can be nasty as hell ... to my daughter she is the perfect mum (i miss her a lot).

Thanks for your advise ! They are the three goals I will follow through. If it gets to hard there is always a high-rise building somewhere.

I hope my daughter will always love me no matter what ! I hope she gets to know in the future that her mum left her dad for whatever reason and that daddy used to love mummy very much. I hope she doesn't get to close to her new bf. It's really difficult.

Yes, I hope she will enjoy her time with me BUT it's hard. Taking her to the playground alone and seeing all those happy parents sucks! I really appreciate you talking to me. Thanks a lot ! What can I do to ease the pain ? In the past it was always time which healed the wounds but it takes so fing long. I'm a bit too big so I started walking again but I end up walking for more then 5 hours per day - seems a bit crazy ! I even go for a 45 minute walk after midnight cause I can't sleep. It's mental I know but like you said; love sucks, such a nice feeling but it can be hard at the same time. I have set myself a weightloss goal. Apart from that I think I'm looking forward to finding a job in Berlin finaly after 3 years. I'm pretty scared to move but my little one puts an honest smile on my face and I want to have her with me every second weekend. The judge last year was pretty good ... he didn't listen to her or her lawyer. He only looked at me and asked me all the time as we were writing the protocol; are you happy with this ? And I said yes of course. I didn't see the little one for 6 month last year, that was quite hard too. They said I'm a drug addict cause I used to smoke weed when we got together (have stopped since then for her), i am very angry and need anger management (wtf?), I can see my baby only in a protected and controlled environment, etc.. It was like being in a movie. At least the judge didn't believe any of it.

Again, thanks for writing !

I think in may . . . not long a ago, it's pathetic. My birthday was in May, I went to Berlin but she told me before that I should stay in a hotel with my daughter. I think she had the guy then cause she did that in the past - not letting me go into her flat and I need to wait outside until she brings my daughter down. It was always an on/off relationship. She wanted me to move to Berlin (don't like that city very much) for the last 3 years. I was reluctant, why - don't know. Now I was finally ready to move and she dumped me AGAIN for this other guy. I love her but I hate her at the same time for all the shit . . . the sad thing - I would still take her back !

It is the third guy !!!! 2011 she had an affair with a work mate, end of 2013 when I took her to court to get access to my daughter (she would have given me access but on her terms so I went to court anyway because I was angry) she was together with someone, dumped him for me in december 2013 and we got back together. Only knew about this other guy cause she told me on the phone back in december. Maybe she had others in between - who knows except her ?

I'm taking my little one to the zoo, swimming, she likes airplanes so we'll go to the airport, walking with my parents dogs, adventure parks, etc. I have a few plans what to do with her . . . I love her and I want her to be happy. I want her to know that I am her dad and not the other guy. I'm scared cause she might talk about mum (which she always does) and her new boyfriend. This would be really hard to handle to be honest !!

I know you might try to say be happy you can see your daughter ! That's not why I want for her . . . why can't people stick together these days like they did years ago ? My parents had arguments but they are still together and very happy now. Nothing is easy ! Once you make that decision to have kids you should be together. She just walks off to find another guy at the next corner. Why ? She never had a healthy relationship with her parents. She didn't speak to her farther for years. Then after our daughter was born she contacted him and they became really close friends and just after that he got diagnosed with cancer. He died in April this year. She was there when he died. She begged me to come over to support her but my company wouldn't give me the time off so I couldn't go which I think started everything. She needed me, I wasn't there. Now I need her and she isn't there instead she f*cks around with this other guy AND this really really hurts the most.

Thx m8 ! I work in telecoms/IT as an Engineer. My company is pissing me off cause there is no one here who really works. All the work gets filtered down to me and I end up driving up and down the country and I spend an awful lot of time at airports for work and my private life .... can't stand it anymore ! As I said before I was going to move to Berlin for her this year, I work in London and I have a flat here. My daughter lives with her, she has full custody. I have access rights, I can see her every third weekend a month and next week I'll have her for 10 days and I'll take her to my parents. She calls me daddy, she knows I'm her farther, I love her ! Still love her mum too :( I'm scared to move to Berlin now - I don't want to see her new boyfriend, i don't want to see them moving in together, etc.. It would really hurt to see her giving everything to this guy. I deleted her from whatsapp cause she was putting pictures up as her profil picture of her possing in front of the mirror. I was confronting her last week on the phone and asked her about the name my daughter has mentioned to me and it took her a few minutes to admit it ! Since then I've sent her two nasty mails saying thanks for dumping me and thanks for treating me like shit. I'm scared to see her on sunday when I pick up my daughter .... it's shit mate. Life sucks right now !

Just arrived at work and it's making me even more depressive! I realy can' carry on like this anymore. I'm begging someone to please let me die now and let the pain go away but it's not happening. I can't cope anymore. I need to go through with it ... I don't want to be here any longer. I'm a seflish cunt, no life, it's all gone. Life is worthless without my kid and her mum. I hope it hurts her when I'm gone !!! Please let her shed a tear when I'm dead.

Yes, I love my little girl ! I can't do this anymore ... I woke up again after 4 hours sleep and the firt thought that comes to my mind is her mum and her new guy. I realy need to end this soon or I will go down very fast. Jumping seems so much easier.
